requirement_snapshot.name: 注册旅客账号
requirement_snapshot.description:
Validation 契约：应用必须支持直接访问 `/register`，首页必须提供可点击的 `Register` 链接进入该页面。注册页必须提供以下稳定且唯一的中文可访问名称，供 Playwright 使用 `getByLabel` 或 `getByRole` 定位，控件必须与对应 label 原生关联，不得依赖 CSS class、DOM 顺序或 placeholder：`用户名` 为必填文本输入框；`登录密码` 为必填密码输入框，并显示随输入动态变化的三段密码强度指示器；`确认密码` 为必填密码输入框；`证件类型` 为必填原生下拉选择框，选项包括“请选择证件类型”（初始值）、“居民身份证”、“护照”、“港澳居民来往内地通行证”、“台湾居民来往大陆通行证”和“外国人永久居留身份证”；`姓名` 为必填文本输入框；`证件号码` 为必填文本输入框；`优惠（待）类型` 为必填原生下拉选择框，初始提示为“请选择乘客类型”，选项包括“成人”、“儿童”、“学生”、“残疾军人”和“其他优惠类型”；`邮箱` 为可选 email 输入框；`国家/地区代码` 为手机号组合控件中的必填下拉选择框，默认值为 `+86`，并至少提供 `+84` 等国际区号；`手机号` 为必填文本输入框；必须有 accessible name 包含 `服务条款` 或 `隐私政策` 的必选复选框；必须有 accessible name 为 `下一步` 的提交按钮。有效数据提交后必须调用注册接口、创建登录会话并导航回 `/`，首页显示提交的用户名和 accessible name 为 `Sign out` 的退出链接，刷新后仍保持登录；缺失、格式错误、密码不一致、重复用户名或重复邮箱、未同意协议时，必须显示可见的中文错误消息，且不得创建账号或登录会话。
实现旅客注册页面和注册接口，从首页点击 `Register` 进入。
页面提供用户名、登录密码、确认密码、证件类型、姓名、证件号码、优惠（待）类型、邮箱、国家/地区代码、手机号、服务条款和隐私政策复选框以及“下一步”按钮。
前端负责必填提示和基础交互，后端必须再次完成全部校验，不能依赖前端结果。
用户名、登录密码、确认密码、证件类型、姓名、证件号码、优惠（待）类型、国家/地区代码和手机号均为必填，邮箱为可选，服务条款和隐私政策必须同意。
姓名去除首尾空格后应包含 2–100 个非空白字符；
证件号码只能包含 6–30 个 ASCII 字母、数字或连字符；
证件类型必须从页面提供的有效选项中选择，优惠（待）类型必须从页面提供的有效选项中选择，手机号必须与国家/地区代码组合通过校验。
用户名只能包含 3–32 个 ASCII 字母、数字、连字符或下划线。
邮箱填写时必须是完整有效的地址且不超过 254 个字符。
登录密码长度为 12–128 个字符，并至少包含大写字母、小写字母、数字和特殊字符；
确认密码必须一致；
用户必须接受服务条款和隐私政策。
用户名和邮箱都必须唯一，邮箱重复判断忽略大小写。
注册接口使用服务端生成的账号标识和会话令牌，禁止返回密码或密码摘要。
有效提交将账号安全写入持久化文件、创建登录会话并返回首页；
页面显示当前用户名和“退出登录”。
任何缺失、格式错误或重复数据都显示明确错误，不得创建账号或会话。
账号写入应采用安全的读改写流程，避免文件损坏和只写入一半的数据。
演示数据使用唯一用户名 `tb-user-<时间戳>-<随机值>`、由该用户名生成的有效邮箱、密码 `Valid-password-123!`、姓名 `Ticket User <时间戳>-<随机值>`、证件类型 `护照`、证件号码 `P<时间戳数字>`、优惠（待）类型 `成人`、国家/地区代码 `+84` 和有效手机号 `912345678`。
重复场景复用相同用户名或邮箱；
无效示例包括用户名 `bad username!`、邮箱 `not-an-email`、密码 `short`、两次密码不一致、缺少证件号码或未勾选协议。
可选视觉参考：![注册页面](./reference/register.png)

{'image_path': './reference/register.png', 'analysis': '### 1. Frontend Style Direction
* **Colors:** Primary blue header bar (#1B7CC4 → #2196D3 gradient); white surfaces (#FFF); label text dark gray (#333); required-asterisk red (#E33); hint/validation text orange (#F60 / #FF8800); link text blue (#3B8FD4); primary button orange (#F5820B); password strength meter red/gray.
* **Typography:** System sans-serif; labels ~14px regular; input placeholder ~14px gray (#999); hints ~13–14px; header title ~16–18px white.
* **Spacing Rhythm:** Medium density; ~16–20px vertical gap between form rows; inputs ~36–40px tall; generous outer padding (~30–40px) inside card; label column right-aligned before inputs.
* **Overall Tone:** Traditional Chinese government/enterprise service form — a single-card, one-column registration wizard step (e.g., account signup flow), functional and authoritative.

### 2. Page Skeleton (Top to Bottom)
* **Section: Page Card**
  * **Purpose:** Contain a multi-step registration form (current step: account info).
  * **Container:** Full-width card, thin blue border, small corner radius (~4px); blue gradient header bar with left-aligned white title; white body.
  * **Children:**
    1. **Header Bar:** Blue gradient strip, white title text ("账户信息" style — account info section title).
    2. **Required Fields Block:** Vertical stack of label + input rows, each label right-aligned with a red asterisk prefix. Rows: username (text input + orange inline hint), login password (password input + strength meter to the right), confirm password, ID-type dropdown, name (input + orange hint with link), ID number (input + orange parenthetical hint), passenger-discount-type dropdown.
    3. **Divider:** Full-width light dashed/dotted horizontal rule separating required and optional groups.
    4. **Optional/Contact Fields Block:** Email row (no asterisk); phone row = country-code dropdown (+86-style select) + phone number input side-by-side, with orange hint text to the right.
    5. **Agreement Row:** Checkbox + text with blue hyperlinks for terms/privacy policy.
    6. **Action Row:** Centered orange primary button ("下一步" — next-step label), pill-ish radius (~4px), width ~200px.
* **Style Notes:** Inputs have light gray borders, white bg, subtle rounding; selects styled identically with chevron; hints only appear to the right of certain inputs, vertically centered with the row.

### 3. Data Presentation Style
* **Pattern Type:** Single-column vertical form; no tables/charts.
* **Visual Structure:** Each row = right-aligned label (fixed width) + input (~350px wide) + optional hint column to the right.
* **Field Types:** short text, password, confirm-password, dropdown (ID type, passenger type), phone with country-code select, email, boolean checkbox.
* **Styling Rules:** Required fields marked with red `*`; optional email lacks asterisk; validation/hints rendered inline in orange to the right of inputs; password strength shown as a 3-segment horizontal bar (colored segment(s) + gray remainder) aligned under/next to the password hint.
* **Do Not Copy Actual Values:** No user data is shown as content; only placeholder and hint copy structure.

### 4. Interaction Surfaces
* **Text inputs:** 5–6 fields, standard bordered style, gray placeholder text describing format rules.
* **Dropdowns:** 3 selects (ID type, discount/passenger type, country/region code) — native-style bordered selects with chevron.
* **Password strength meter:** 3-segment bar that updates live (weak=red → medium → strong), rendered beside the password row.
* **Checkbox + links:** agreement consent checkbox; two blue inline hyperlinks (service terms, privacy policy) that should open dialogs or new pages.
* **Primary button:** centered orange "next step" CTA — the only primary control; no visible secondary/cancel button.
* **Inline hints:** orange text and one orange underlined link (name-fill rules) that likely triggers a popover/tooltip.

### 5. Frontend Requirements Summary
* **Must Preserve:** Blue-gradient card header; single-column labeled form with right-aligned labels and red required asterisks; inline orange hint column; dashed divider between required and optional sections; 3-segment password strength indicator; centered orange primary CTA; blue link styling for legal docs.
* **Runtime-Driven Areas:** Dropdown options (ID types, passenger types, country codes), validation messages, password strength state, hint/tooltips, checkbox state, and any multi-step wizard progression must be data/state driven.
* **Avoid:** Seeding placeholders/hints as actual input values; hardcoding dropdown options or legal link targets from the screenshot; reproducing specific regulatory/site-specific copy as UI content.', 'resolved_image_path': 'D:\code\arc-visual-reference-dict-214\arc-bench-test\easy-ticketbooking\requirements\reference\register.png'}

interfaces.name: registerValidation
interfaces.responsibility: Server-side field validation for registration payloads; single source of truth for error codes.
interfaces.specification: validateRegistrationInput(input) -> { valid, fields: {field: code} }. Codes: REQUIRED_/INVALID_/DUPLICATE_ per field (DUPLICATE_* checked by repo, merged here via authService). Rules: username /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{3,32}$/; password 12-128 with upper+lower+digit+special; confirmPassword equals; idType in ID_TYPES; name trimmed 2-100 non-space chars; idNumber /^[A-Za-z0-9-]{6,30}$/; passengerType in PASSENGER_TYPES; email optional, valid, <=254; countryCode in COUNTRY_CODES; phone digits valid for code (+84: 9 digits; others 11 starting 1); agreement required.
interfaces.test_focus: Unit tests per field rule and code; boundary lengths.

interfaces.name: accountsRepository
interfaces.first_line: // REQ-1 persistence for passenger accounts and login sessions.
interfaces.responsibility: SQLite persistence for accounts and sessions via shared db_runtime helpers; idempotent schema.
interfaces.specification: ensureSchema creates accounts(id PK uuid, username UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE, email COLLATE NOCASE UNIQUE, password_hash, id_type, name, id_number, passenger_type, country_code, phone, created_at) and sessions(token PK, account_id FK, created_at). API: findAccountByUsername (NOCASE), findAccountByEmail (lower() compare), createAccountWithSession, createSessionForAccount, findAccountBySessionToken, deleteSession — all transactional/safe writes; never return password_hash.
interfaces.test_focus: Integration tests on isolated DB: uniqueness case-insensitive, session join, no hash leakage.

interfaces.name: authService
interfaces.first_line: // REQ-1 auth service: account creation + session lifecycle.
interfaces.responsibility: Orchestrates validation, uniqueness checks, secure account creation and session lifecycle.
interfaces.specification: registerAccount(payload): validate -> check DUPLICATE_USERNAME/DUPLICATE_EMAIL via repo -> bcrypt hash (10 rounds) -> createAccountWithSession with crypto.randomUUID id and crypto.randomBytes(32).hex token -> { ok, account, token } or { ok:false, fields }. authenticateSessionToken(token), createSession, destroySession, sessionCookieOptions (httpOnly, sameSite lax, path /, 7-day maxAge), SESSION_COOKIE='tb_session'. No password/hash in any return.
interfaces.test_focus: Unit/integration: duplicate detection merges field codes; session create/auth/destroy.

interfaces.name: authRoutes
interfaces.responsibility: HTTP boundary for registration, current-user, logout.
interfaces.specification: POST /api/auth/register: 200 { code:200, account:{id,username,email,name} } + sets tb_session httpOnly cookie; 400 { code:400, error:'VALIDATION_FAILED', fields:{field:code} }. GET /api/auth/me: 200 { code:200, account } or 401 { code:401 }. POST /api/auth/logout: always 200, destroys session + clears cookie. Route mounted at /api/auth in app.js.
interfaces.test_focus: Supertest: success sets cookie + persists; each failure returns correct field codes; /me works after register; logout clears.

interfaces.name: backend app wiring (reused shared surface)
interfaces.responsibility: Shared Express app; extended additively to mount authRoutes.
interfaces.specification: Reused interface: two additive edits only — import authRoutes and app.use('/api/auth', authRoutes) before static/SPA fallback. No other changes.
interfaces.test_focus: Supertest against app; SPA fallback unaffected.

interfaces.name: registerValidation (frontend)
interfaces.first_line: // REQ-1 frontend: register form validation + password strength helpers.
interfaces.responsibility: Client-side validation, dropdown option sets, password strength scoring.
interfaces.specification: Exports ID_TYPES (with 请选择证件类型 default), PASSENGER_TYPES (请选择乘客类型 default), COUNTRY_CODES (+86 default, +84 included); passwordStrength(pw) 0..3; validateRegisterForm(values) -> field->Chinese message map mirroring backend rules; RegisterFormValues type.
interfaces.test_focus: Vitest unit: rules mirror backend; strength segments 0-3.

interfaces.name: registerApi (frontend)
interfaces.first_line: // REQ-1 frontend API client for auth endpoints.
interfaces.responsibility: Axios calls for register / me / logout through the shared apiClient.
interfaces.specification: register(payload): POST /api/auth/register; 200 -> {ok:true}; 400 -> {ok:false, fields}. fetchCurrentUser(): GET /api/auth/me -> account | null on 401. signOut(): POST /api/auth/logout. Uses shared apiClient (interceptor contract stays intact).
interfaces.test_focus: Mocked axios unit tests for ok/field-error/401 paths.

interfaces.name: RegisterPage
interfaces.responsibility: Registration form UI at /register with accessible-name contract and error rendering.
interfaces.specification: Native label-input association for: 用户名, 登录密码 (password, with 3-segment strength meter updated on input), 确认密码, 证件类型 select (options from ID_TYPES, initial 请选择证件类型), 姓名, 证件号码, 优惠（待）类型 select (initial 请选择乘客类型), 邮箱 optional email, 国家/地区代码 select default +86, 手机号, checkbox accessible name containing 服务条款/隐私政策 (required), button 下一步. Submit: client validation -> visible role=alert Chinese errors, no API call; else register(); on success refresh session and navigate('/'); on field errors render per-field messages. Styling per visual reference: blue card header, labeled rows with red asterisks, orange 下一步 button.
interfaces.test_focus: jsdom render tests: labels, selects, strength meter, client errors block submission, success path calls API + navigates.

interfaces.name: SessionContext
interfaces.responsibility: Global current-user state shared by all pages; loaded from GET /api/auth/me.
interfaces.specification: SessionProvider fetches current user on mount (loading state while pending), exposes { user, loading, refresh, signOut } via context; signOut calls POST /api/auth/logout then refresh. useSession hook for consumers. Persistence across refresh is cookie-based (server session), so reload keeps user.
interfaces.test_focus: jsdom: refresh loads user from /me; signOut clears user.

interfaces.name: HeaderAuthSlot
interfaces.first_line: // REQ-1 frontend: header auth slot rendering real session state.
interfaces.responsibility: Renders session-dependent header auth area, mounted into ROOT-owned SiteHeader authSlot.
interfaces.specification: Signed-in: username text + Sign out link (aria-label Sign out) that calls useSession().signOut. Guest: 注册 link to /register and 登录 link to /login.
interfaces.test_focus: jsdom: guest shows 注册/登录; signed-in shows username + Sign out; click Sign out calls signOut.

interfaces.name: HomePage (reused shared surface)
interfaces.responsibility: Shared home page; extended additively to mount HeaderAuthSlot and provide Register entry.
interfaces.specification: Reused interface: additive edit mounting <SiteHeader authSlot={<HeaderAuthSlot />} />. TODO for TDD: header/nav composition must include a clickable Register link (to /register) in the auth area when guest. No other changes.
interfaces.test_focus: jsdom: guest home shows Register link; after register flow shows username + Sign out.

interfaces.name: App routes (reused shared surface)
interfaces.responsibility: Shared route table; extended additively with /register.
interfaces.specification: Reused interface: additive import + <Route path="/register" element={<RegisterPage />} />. TDD should also wrap Routes in SessionProvider (or mount it in main.tsx) so all pages share session state.
interfaces.test_focus: Route resolution for /register; session provider present.

test_artifacts.first_line: // REQ-1 auth service: account creation + session lifecycle.
// REQ-1 frontend: register form validation + password strength helpers.
// REQ-1 frontend API client for auth endpoints.
// REQ-1 frontend: shared home page composition test.
// REQ-1 E2E: passenger registration flows against the backend-hosted app.

test_summary: Coverage by layer for REQ-1 (passenger registration). Backend unit: registerValidation.test.js covers every field rule (username regex/boundaries, password 12–128 with all char classes, confirm equality, ID/passenger type option membership, name 2–100 trimmed, idNumber 6–30 ASCII, email ≤254, +84 9-digit / +86 11-digit phone rules, agreement). Backend integration: accountsRepository.test.js (isolated harness) verifies case-insensitive username/email lookup, unique-violation rejection, session create/auth/delete and no hash leakage; authService.test.js covers registerAccount field-code merging (DUPLICATE_USERNAME/EMAIL), session token lifecycle (64-hex token) and cookie contract; authRoutes.test.js (supertest, harness-before-import ordering) drives POST /api/auth/register (200 envelope + tb_session httpOnly cookie + /api/auth/me round trip), per-field 400 VALIDATION_FAILED codes, and logout clearing sessions. Frontend unit: registerValidation.test.ts asserts the exact dropdown option sets (+86/+84), passwordStrength 0–3 monotonicity and Chinese error messages mirroring backend; registerApi.test.ts mocks the shared apiClient for ok/field-error/401/logout paths. Frontend integration: RegisterPage.test.tsx locks the stable Chinese accessible-name contract (labels natively associated, initial select values 请选择证件类型/请选择乘客类型/+86, 3-segment strength meter via data-testid), blocks submission on missing/mismatched/unsigned-agreement input with role=alert Chinese errors and no API call, and asserts success navigates to / with the session refreshed; homePage.test.tsx (shared scope) verifies the guest Register link to /register and signed-in username + `Sign out` link. E2E (backend/test-e2e/register.e2e.spec.js) compiles all three scenarios with unique-per-run demo identities (tb-user-<ts>-<rand>, +84/912345678), verifying: valid registration → navigation to /, username + Sign out visible, /api/auth/me 200, session persists across reload; invalid submissions (unsigned agreement, password mismatch, bad username) show visible Chinese errors and never produce a session (me 401) with full per-submit input resets; duplicate username and case-insensitive duplicate email are rejected in fresh contexts leaving the original account intact. Owned behavior is RED on the design skeleton (empty repos/routes/pages), satisfying the green-baseline gate.
